name: The Tasting Room
deal: Date Night: Spaghetti and Meatballs for two with a glass of wine each for R215 per couple. All day.
howToClaim: Visit any Tasting Room branch on a Monday or Tuesday and ask for the Date Night special. See page 4 of the menu PDF for all promos.

name: Hussar Grill
deal: Date Night Set Menu: 2 courses for R499 per couple or 3 courses for R599 per couple. Includes a bottle of wine or two soft drinks.
howToClaim: Call to book your table. Ask to be transferred to your nearest branch as there are multiple locations.

name: Kream (Montecasino)
deal: Date Night: R850 per couple with a complimentary bottle of champagne. Monday and Tuesday evenings only.
howToClaim: Book a table in advance – this exclusive offer fills quickly on Monday and Tuesday evenings.

name: Signs Restaurant
deal: One of Johannesburg's most acclaimed fine dining establishments. Expect beautifully plated dishes, impeccable attentive service and a stunning interior that makes Signs the natural choice for a special occasion, a milestone celebration or a genuinely memorable date night. This is the sort of place that raises the bar for what an evening out can be.

name: Nine Lives Speakeasy
deal: Tucked inside Hyde Hotels in Rosebank, Nine Lives is a dark, atmospheric speakeasy-style bar and restaurant. Low lighting, intimate seating and expertly crafted cocktails set the scene, while the food is genuinely excellent, making this far more than just a bar. Perfect for a date night where you want the setting to do half the work.
howToClaim: Visit Nine Lives at Hyde Hotels, Rosebank, Johannesburg. Walk-ins welcome but booking recommended for busy evenings. Call: 010 023 2600.
